transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: Independent red-teams need to verify whether the model's behavior is genuinely anomalous/deceptive and assess actual capability and misalignment risk before any major decision.

actions.rationale: Independent red-teams need to verify whether the model's behavior is genuinely anomalous/deceptive and assess actual capability and misalignment risk before any major decision.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Congress and key committees must be briefed on a potential AI capability breakthrough and China timeline before I can justify unilateral action on pause, acceleration, or control measures.

actions.rationale: Congress and key committees must be briefed on a potential AI capability breakthrough and China timeline before I can justify unilateral action on pause, acceleration, or control measures.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Third-party audits and incident reporting will give us real-time visibility into what's actually happening with the system and catch any escalation while we assess the larger picture.

actions.rationale: Third-party audits and incident reporting will give us real-time visibility into what's actually happening with the system and catch any escalation while we assess the larger picture.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.
